_comment: THE M3EPBUGGIN CHANNEL -- the operator's test version: Community Edition plus the
community-mods test features, each one a `files` add-on. Players pick M3epbuggin in the
modified launcher; it switches on main + this channel.
Every file is measured against Community Edition 2026.09.28-1: a delta from the stock
bytes where the game ships the file and nobody edits it (MAPS.SM0), whole otherwise
(new plugins, their .ini). The exe is main's SMOKE file, so M3CHAT ships it whole with
"over": "SMOKE", the form Experimental's DEVBLD uses: a launcher puts SMOKE's exe back
Experimental ships some of the same paths (the exe, MAPS.SM0, SpyGrab.asi/.ini,
SniperHeadshotSound.asi, QolHud.asi). The two channels are never live together, so the
build reports those files instead of refusing them; an install must hold the add-ons of
only one of the two (README.md: remove Experimental's first).
name: SCDA Community Edition -- M3epbuggin test build

addons.title: Chat and HUD -- chat lines at once, no boxes; dead players can chat; HUD stays on in the drone and the scope
addons.notes: The bottom-left chat shows each line at once as plain text: no slide-in, no background box, no icon, newest at the bottom, rows one line apart. Dead players can chat: on the host, a dead player's lines reach everyone, and the chat also shows while you are dead, in the kill cam and spectating. A merc flying the drone or looking through the scope keeps the normal HUD (timer, zone name, score, gadgets, radar, prompts, chat), drawn on top of the view.

addons.title: No-mic fix -- the game starts without a microphone
addons.notes: On a PC with no working microphone the game no longer crashes during start-up (SCDA_Online.exe+37A133). Voice send stays off; hearing the other players keeps working. With a working microphone it does nothing.
addons._status: no-mic-guard (m4): NoMicGuard.asi md5 cc449c0d, three in-memory hooks in the voice init, each byte-checked at load. Gated on CE 2026.10.02-5's SMOKE exe 4a17634f and M3CHAT's 0fd28e5f (105 PASS 0 FAIL, harness 21/21 each); started without a microphone on the test version 2026-10-05: main menu, alive at 90 s.

addons.title: Join crash fix -- the HUD waits for your character
addons.notes: A player joining a match no longer crashes while loading in (SCDA_Online.exe+271EDA): the game built the HUD before the player's character had arrived. The HUD is now built in the first frame the character exists. When the character is already there it does nothing.
addons._status: two-player-load-crash (m5): ResetHudDefer.asi md5 4e3396c4, two in-memory hooks (HUD builder 0x10B71340 defer, AHUD vtable +0x440 replay), each checked against its stock content at load. Static gate 52 PASS 0 FAIL on 0fd28e5f, fc237f82, 4a17634f, 0f1b2d1c, 4dccc646. Not yet seen running in a two-player game.

addons.title: Modes crash fix -- no crash while a map loads
addons.notes: The game no longer crashes while a map loads (Modes.asi+9F75): Community Edition's Modes.asi kept scanning the game's name list from a background thread for up to 10 minutes and read it while the game was moving it. That scan is skipped; the end-of-round messages still look the names up themselves. Every player benefits on their own PC.
addons._status: modes-name-scan-fix (m7): Community Edition 2026.10.02-5's Modes.asi (MAPOBJ, md5 e5d6f25e) with the install thread's name-retry loop skipped, 2 edits at RVA 0xBF30 / 0xBF42 (8 bytes written, 7 differ, no relocation over them); result md5 f04f5a9d, same size. Gate 8 PASS 0 FAIL. Shipped whole over MAPOBJ, so a launcher puts MAPOBJ's Modes.asi back when M3MODF goes off. Crash measured 2026-10-07 on a joining client loading BLKG1_VS. Not yet seen running in game.

addons.title: Sniper headshot sound
addons.notes: When a merc kills a spy with a scoped headshot, a short ding plays where the spy fell, heard within 10 metres. The host needs the plugin; the ding itself is in Community Edition's own sound bank (MAPS.SM0 of Club House and Warehouse, since 2026.10.02-3).
addons._status: sniper-headshot-sound v3 (m3): the plugin only, SniperHeadshotSound.asi md5 9e9dcfc0. The Ding sample and its 10 m range ride in main's CLUBEX MAPS.SM0 (f6f129b7 in 2026.10.02-3: turret cue sample = the Ding, parameter 7 = 10.0), so this channel ships and replaces no bank. v2 (m1, m2) shipped MAPS.SM0 e681dfbd as a delta on stock d8e31526.

addons.title: HUD stays on in the drone and the scope
addons.notes: A merc looking through the scope or flying the drone keeps the normal HUD (timer, zone name, score, gadgets, messages), drawn on top of the view.
addons._status: qol-hud v3 (QolHud.asi md5 722365f7). Adds one plugin, replaces nothing; settings optional in Enhanced.ini [QOLHUD].

addons.title: Spy grab -- end of the spin, wall stagger and stairs
addons.notes: A spy can grab a merc in the last half second of the berserk spin, during the whole stagger after a wall sprint, and on stairs. Every player needs it.
addons._status: spy-grab-merc v2 (Experimental x40). SpyGrab.asi md5 ca67503e, SpyGrab.ini md5 36c34fa4.

addons.title: QOL4Necks -- neck a jumping or landing merc, neck before switches
addons.notes: A spy can neck a merc in the middle of a jump and right after he lands, and an interact press next to a light switch or other object necks a merc in reach first.

addons.title: Root berzerk -- spin out of the wall stagger
addons.notes: A merc who sprints into a wall can start the berserk spin at any moment of the stagger instead of having the key swallowed until it ends. Same button, same 1.5 s cooldown, same reload and crouch rules as the stock spin. Only the merc's own PC needs it; bots stay stock.
addons._status: root-berzerk v2 (m6): RootBerzerk.asi md5 fa93639a, one in-memory hook of 7 bytes at 0x10BC7A29 (tail of MercWaitForSprintBump.PlayerTick), byte-checked at load; role test RemoteRole != 3 (v1 fdac01a0 had it inverted and never spun). RootBerzerk.ini md5 218858ae (Enabled=1 Bump=0 Log=1). Static gate 121 PASS 0 FAIL and harness 945 checks 0 FAIL on 0fd28e5f, fc237f82, 4a17634f, 0f1b2d1c, 4dccc646; no overlap with the channel's other plugins. Not yet seen running in game.
